scope: Prevent false inactive certificates on a different executor; synthetic process fixtures, no physical calculation or Library publication.
criteria: Different boot with no processes or reused PID must yield UNKNOWN_ACTIVITY and active=null.
Same boot, complete process query and no worker can yield observed inactivity.
Matching coordinator or orphan pipeline on same boot remains active.
Incomplete query without positive activity remains unknown.
amendment: Public synthetic fixtures use fictitious process identifiers; real executor details remain private. Same administrative criteria; no physics.
